rationale: mc_rst_q is registered on clk_a from a synchronised boot reset and a registered run request, so the exported reset changes only on clk_a edges. Its D is held low by the boot chain while por_ni releases.

author_reading.rationale: The memory controller reset is registered on clk_a from a synchronised boot reset and a registered run request, so it changes only on a clock edge.

labels.rationale: All of mc_rst_q is on clk_a with the same async reset. mc_rst_no is registered, so its output changes only at clk edges. boot_rst_q is used as data and does not drive an async reset.
The exported reset is registered and the boot chain holds its D input low during release. The run condition is sampled on the same clock, so no combinational mux hazard reaches the output.
labels.suspected_flaw: The comment describes a registered select, while the implementation registers the result. The downstream reset pin and receiving clock are outside the case.
